in_sanskrit.name: गायत्रिय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gāyatrī is the goddess of the Vedic hymn known as the Gāyatrī mantra, which is chanted daily by millions of Hindus. Gāyatrī is considered to be the personification of Vedic wisdom and the mother of the Vedas. The name Gāyatrī is derived from the Sanskrit word gāyatra, which refers to a type of hymn or meter used in the Rigveda.
